status: DRAFTS ONLY: nothing approved, no template approved, no alpha charged, no market data read or tested, no network, no database

rules.coverage_first: a mechanism already covered by a registered family/test is dropped as covered (no renaming)
rules.data_gates: forward data that exists or is PROPOSED; history only after 2026-11-14 and only <= 2023-12-31 (2025+ reserved, 2024 holdout never); COIN-M from 2026-11-28
rules.power: power >= 0.8 at a stated plausible effect (p2_power.sr_power at alpha_F 0.0125, K = 1), else REDESIGN/PARKED
rules.power_mapping: non-Sharpe estimands: sr_power(e, n_eff, per_year=1, alpha) = one-sided test of a mean with standardised effect e per independent observation; this is what desk_factory.check_power computes from plausible_sr/n_planned/per_year
rules.amendment8_point14: defined for daily net-return Sharpe; not applicable to the measurement/risk estimands here (as for F2)

scoring.E: independent evidence (5 replicated peer-reviewed ... 1 practitioner only)
scoring.D: data within gates (5 existing forward stream, 4 PROPOSED stream, 3 history after 11-14, 2 COIN-M/new host, 1 not available)
scoring.P: power at a plausible effect (5 >= 0.8 in <= 12 months ... 1 < 0.3)
scoring.C: cost and capacity realism (5 = no trading/measurement)
scoring.A: distance from previously rejected Copybot hypotheses
scoring.I: information value of a negative result
scoring.note: scores rank only; the coverage rule is applied first, so a high-scoring covered mechanism is still dropped
